title: F2b has no item for the client half of the wave A SQL refusals and flags
why_needed: The uncommitted M1a/M1b migrations add FULFILLMENT_STOPPED and REFUND_IN_FLIGHT (fulfillment_update), PAYMENT_REVERSED (order_resolve), CHARGEBACK_RECORDED (refund_request), the per-item `stopped` flag (order_detail) and the reasons REFUNDED_BEFORE_SETTLE and MODE_CHANGED; the order and reconciliation screens and refunds.ts word all of them as a generic retry or a raw code (ADMIN-COMMERCE-01, -02, -03, -15). The rulings list F2b-1, -2, -5, -8 and CONTRACT/EF-ADMIN items, none of these.
touches: src/lib/admin-orders.ts (REFUSALS, itemOf, REVIEW_REASON_LABELS, RECONCILIATION_REASON_LABELS), src/components/admin/OrderView.tsx (choosable, fulfil), supabase/functions/_shared/refunds.ts (REFUSALS), tests/unit/admin-orders.test.ts, tests/e2e/orders-admin.spec.ts

title: No way for the owner to file other-mode work after the switch to live
why_needed: A sandbox attempt parked MODE_CHANGED (M1a-6) and a sandbox refund in flight (CONTRACT-04) stay on «المطابقة» and in «تحتاج مطابقة» permanently: the recheck cannot see another mode's row (payment_attempt_ref and the refund fetch are mode-bound) and no dismiss exists (ADMIN-COMMERCE-14). The E02 cut-over will create such rows unless every sandbox attempt is settled first.
touches: a new owner-only SQL function (attempt/refund dismiss with audit), supabase/functions/_shared/admin.ts or a direct RPC, src/components/admin/ReconciliationView.tsx, docs/payments-runbook.md cut-over steps

title: E02 run 6 must feed the order_resolve reversal rule, not only the runbook
why_needed: Moyasar documents status 'refunded' after a partial refund and the emulator models it; the new PAYMENT_REVERSED rule reads that status as a full reversal, and its integration test assumes the opposite (ADMIN-COMMERCE-12). The sandbox answer decides the rule; the plan records it only as a runbook observation.
